front: Why report error relative to seasonal naive?
back: It is scale-free and shows value added: below 1 means better than a free baseline.
exp(mean(log ratio)). A 2x gain and a 2x loss give 1.0, which is fair. The arithmetic mean is not.
Weighted quantile loss: mean over quantile levels of 2·sum(pinball loss) / sum(|y|).
Pre-training overlap (leakage), vendor self-reporting, tuning on the benchmark. Also weak baselines.

front: How to quote a leaderboard result?
back: State date, benchmark version, metric and model version. Leaderboards change monthly.
